note: The personal file's fields, as the tools read them. 'what' and 'why' are word for word from the tables in references/personal-file.md, and the tests check that the two agree, so change them there first and here second. Key types: text, number, date (YYYY-MM-DD), partdate (a year, a year and month, or a full date), when (a date, with or without a time), bool, texts (a list), doses (dose lines, as 'schedule -h' describes them), contact (free text that may hold a phone number), phone, yes_no_unknown.

fields.name: call_me
fields.why: so you are addressed as you wish

fields.name: title
fields.what: Ms, Mr, Mx, Dr, or none
fields.why: he is formal; this sets the form

fields.name: pronouns
fields.why: used from the first reply, always

fields.name: gender_identity
fields.why: respect, and how to speak about them

fields.name: species
fields.what: as the person is, e.g. human, dragon, red fox
fields.why: how he sees and addresses them, and in-world care in stories

fields.name: medical_reference
fields.what: which body the real-world data applies to; for any real person, human
fields.why: see Species below

fields.name: date_of_birth
fields.why: age is computed, never stored

fields.name: region
fields.why: region pack, emergency numbers, units

fields.name: languages
fields.why: which language a visit brief or card is written in

fields.name: units
fields.why: how he shows figures

fields.name: communication_needs
fields.what: anything that helps: plain language, short answers, larger text, a support person
fields.why: so he can actually be understood

fields.name: sex_assigned_at_birth
fields.why: some reference ranges, some label warnings and some screening depend on it; used only there, and he says so when he uses it

fields.name: hormone_therapy
fields.why: it can change which lab ranges apply, and what interacts

fields.name: screening_organs
fields.why: which screenings apply, whatever the gender

fields.name: height_cm
fields.why: product labels dose some medicines by weight; a stale weight gets asked again

fields.name: weight_kg
fields.why: product labels dose some medicines by weight; a stale weight gets asked again

fields.name: blood_type
fields.why: for the emergency card

fields.name: baseline_vitals
fields.what: usual blood pressure, resting pulse, usual temperature, with dates
fields.why: so a reading can be compared with that person's normal

fields.name: menstrual
fields.why: timing of symptoms, pregnancy questions, some labels

fields.name: contraception
fields.why: interactions, and some label warnings

fields.name: pregnancy
fields.why: changes what is safe; expires after 30 days and is asked again when it matters

fields.name: breastfeeding
fields.why: changes what is safe; expires after 30 days and is asked again when it matters

fields.name: implants_devices
fields.label: what
fields.what: pacemaker, joint replacement, coil, stents, hearing implant
fields.why: scans, interactions, the emergency card

fields.name: sensory_aids
fields.why: practical, and for the card

fields.name: disabilities_access
fields.why: access needs at visits, and how to help

fields.name: allergies
fields.label: substance
fields.why: checked before anything else in a medicine question

fields.name: intolerances
fields.label: substance
fields.what: food or medicine, and what happens
fields.why: different from an allergy; matters for food and for some products

fields.name: conditions
fields.label: in_their_words
fields.what: in the person's own words, dated
fields.why: only what they stated

fields.name: mental_health
fields.label: in_their_words
fields.what: in the person's own words, if they want it on file
fields.why: some medicines interact, and it changes how he talks with them

fields.name: past_procedures
fields.label: what
fields.what: operations, hospital stays, serious injuries, with years
fields.why: history a real doctor will ask for

fields.name: family_history
fields.label: what
fields.what: what runs in the family, as told
fields.why: screening questions for the doctor

fields.name: kidney_liver
fields.what: known problems: yes, no or unknown
fields.why: many labels change for either

fields.name: vaccinations
fields.label: name
fields.why: seasonal checks, and the doctor's questions

fields.name: recent_travel
fields.label: where
fields.what: where and when, the last few months
fields.why: some symptoms only make sense with it

fields.name: medicines
fields.label: name
fields.what: name, strength, how taken, schedule times, since when, prescribed by, pack size and date opened
fields.why: interaction watch, medicine schedule, refill reminders

fields.name: supplements
fields.label: name
fields.why: they interact too

fields.name: substance_use
fields.label: in_their_words
fields.what: anything else that matters for interactions, in the person's words
fields.why: asked once, without judgement, and only with the reason given

fields.name: habits
fields.why: interactions and food advice

fields.name: sleep
fields.why: desk health, and many symptoms

fields.name: activity
fields.why: context for symptoms and advice

fields.name: work_exposures
fields.what: long screen hours, night shifts, noise, chemicals
fields.why: desk health, and the doctor's questions

fields.name: care_contacts
fields.why: visit prep and the card; phone numbers only if they want them kept

fields.name: appointments
fields.label: with
fields.why: visit brief and reminders

fields.name: care_wishes
fields.what: e.g. organ donation, anything they want a doctor to know in a crisis
fields.why: the card, if they choose

fields.name: share_with
fields.what: which household minds may see what
fields.why: default: nobody (see Confidentiality)

fields.name: settings
fields.what: seasonal checks, desk notices, weekly round, wellbeing check-ins (and how often)
fields.why: features they opted into

fields.name: ignition
fields.why: the gate; the person types these in themselves

fields.name: symptom_diary
fields.label: what
fields.what: date, what, severity 0 to 10, what helped, notes
fields.why: visit brief

fields.name: lab_results
fields.label: test
fields.what: date, test, value, unit, the range printed on that report, lab, flag
fields.why: lab trends

household.name: cabinet
household.label: name
household.what: home medicines: name, strength, expiry, opened

household.name: kits
household.label: where
household.what: home and car first-aid kits: contents and expiry dates

household.name: dependants
household.what: other people the person cares for, each with the same fields and their own consent
household.why: a child's weight for a label dose, a parent's medicine list
